---
name: readme-and-seo-writing
description: "Use when rewriting Gate-OS README, project metadata, docs-site SEO, release notes, or community onboarding."
---

## Procedure
Start with a truthful one-line pitch; link install/build docs; include environment and architecture tables; add concept labels, attribution, license boundaries, roadmap, and contribution paths; verify every badge, URL, metric, and keyword.

## Verification
Markdown links resolve, MkDocs builds, descriptions are natural and within platform limits, and no unsupported claim appears.
